prompt: Write 6510 code to set CIA #1 Timer A to generate an IRQ about 60 times per second, and explain the registers involved.
assertions: Loads the Timer A latch at $DC04/$DC05
Enables the Timer A interrupt in the ICR $DC0D (with bit 7 set to mark 'set', bit 0 for timer A)
Starts the timer via control register A $DC0E (with continuous reload)
Acknowledges/handles by reading $DC0D in the IRQ handler
